Perfect! All 54 tests pass. I've implemented invoice numbering with the following:

**src/numbering.js** - `nextInvoiceNumber(existingNumbers, issueDate)`:
- Generates numbers in format INV-YYYY-NNNN
- Counter resets each year
- Handles unsorted existing numbers and other years correctly
- Zero-pads counter to 4 digits

**src/invoices.js** - `issueInvoice(invoice, existingNumbers)`:
- Assigns next available number using nextInvoiceNumber
- Changes status from 'draft' to 'issued'
- Returns NOT_DRAFT if invoice isn't a draft
- Never mutates the input invoice

The implementation includes 11 new tests covering:
- First number of the year (INV-2026-0001)
- Counter incrementing
- Unsorted existing numbers
- Year resets
- Ignoring numbers from other years
- Padding and large counter edge cases
- Issuing with proper number assignment and status change
- Error handling and immutability
